Data of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual (chapter 8)

Source: R/data.R
data_manual.Rd

Current prices and price indices of two products (A and B) used in the examples of the chapter 8 (price and volume measures) of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual. imf_cp and imf_pi are current prices and elementary price indices over the previous year (average of the previous year = 100) of the example 8.2. The price indices are not available in 2010 (reference year).

Usage

imf_cp

imf_pi

Format

Quarterly mts from 2010Q1 to 2013Q4 with two columns (A and B).

An object of class mts (inherits from ts, matrix) with 16 rows and 2 columns.

Source

Tables and charts of the examples of the chapter 8 (Price and Volume Measures) of the IMF Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .

References

International Monetary Fund (2018), Quarterly National Accounts Manual (2017 Edition), chapter 8 "Price and Volume Measures", Washington, DC. doi:10.5089/9781475589870.069 .
